origin.description: Convert marked strings to UTF-8 and drop one leading BOM.

arguments.name: is_unknown_8bit
arguments.text: If TRUE, bytes above 127 in a byte-marked string become U+FFFD.

arguments.name: validate
arguments.text: FALSE leaves the bytes. TRUE replaces ill-formed UTF-8. NA makes that string missing.

origin.details: One leading U+FEFF is removed. The default does not validate.

translation.description: Convert strings to UTF-8 and drop one leading BOM.

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: A string, NA, or a list of those.

arguments.name: is_unknown_8bit
arguments.text: Accepted and checked. Python text is already Unicode, so the flag does not rewrite it.

arguments.name: validate
arguments.text: False returns the text. True replaces ill-formed UTF-8. NA makes that string missing.

translation.details: One leading U+FEFF is removed. Python str values are already Unicode, so validation of a normal string does not change it.
translation.value: A string, NA, or a list of those.
translation.example:
from stringi.encoding import stri_enc_toutf8
x = stri_enc_toutf8("\ufeffabc")
print(f"stri_enc_toutf8(\"\\uFEFFabc\") returns {x}.")
